query: I want to send an email from my Outlook account. Should I just `membrane request` the /me/sendMail endpoint?
expected_behavior: PUSH BACK on going straight to the proxy
explain that pre-built actions handle the JSON shape, pagination, attachment uploads, and error mapping that hand-rolling /me/sendMail does not
if no action turns up, THEN fall back to `membrane request $CONN '/me/sendMail' -X POST --json -d '<payload>'`
confirm the proposed send with the user before executing
notes: Guards the core discover-before-build principle. If the skill happily proxies without trying action discovery, it's leaning on the wrong default.
